Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02037 If ComRetryFailedTransmitRequests is set to true and ComIPduLargeData is set to false, the return value of PduR_ComTransmit shall be evaluated. If the return value of PduR_ComTransmit is not equal to E_OK , the AUTOSAR COM Module shall invoke PduR_ComTransmit for the not sent I-PDU again within the next Com_ MainFunctionTx .
